0022600167.text: The Houston Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home, 2nd in the West) host the Boston Celtics (5-1, 4-0 on the road... ) as the Rockets' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Boston enters on a five-game winning streak, sits 3rd in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic, and has no games yet this season against Houston, while the 2025-26 series was split 1-1. Houston lost the last meeting 114-93 in Houston on February 4, 2026, and the Rockets are missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), with Reed Sheppard listed as day-to-day with a back injury and a game-time decision. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with a rest designation and a game-time decision.
